verdict.rationale: Fin has automations (Procedures, workflows), so this axis applies, but the pack never documents version history, change review, or rollback for them. The closest material is a statement about testing before go-live and rolling out changes "with control". That is pre-launch testing and staged rollout, a related but different capability that earns no credit for versioning or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
